correctness.rationale: Exact normalized monomial norms and even kernel are derived by beta integration and binomial parity; the Cayley-principal-log calculation exhaustively yields one simple root in the disk for 0<alpha<=1 and none for -1<alpha<=0. Induced even norm is equivalent to A^2_alpha. Division by b_a is bounded on the codimension-one vanishing space, so wandering dimension equals one and its generator is an evaluation kernel that vanishes at another disk point, whereas 1 does not. Degree-one minimality follows from weighted composition unitary automorphism equivalence and the published M_z WSP theorem for alpha<=1. 363 exact rational checks corroborate finite identities only.

value.rationale: The least degree of a finite Blaschke product destroying WSP is a natural structural threshold. The source leaves the degree unspecified and exhibits degree three at alpha=0; showing degree two throughout the positive-weight interval using a sharp analytic parity-kernel root answers a genuinely motivated gap. It contrasts with the full degree-one positive theorem and reveals an exact alpha=0 boundary, beyond a routine specialization, finite recomputation or cosmetic substitution.
